storeListingCopy.fullDescription:
SERP DreamCam Downloader makes it easy to record live streams and download recordings from DreamCam (dreamcamtrue.com).

How it works: Go to any model page on DreamCam and either click the capture button on the player or the extension icon in your toolbar. For live streams, click Start to begin recording and Stop when you're done. For recorded videos, pick your quality and hit Download. The extension converts HLS streams to standard MP4 files in your browser.

It handles LL-HLS streaming, Mouflon manifest decoding, multi-CDN host resolution, and VR stream metadata automatically — no external tools, no command line, no technical knowledge required. Videos save directly to your Downloads folder in an organized DREAMCAM subfolder.

Key features:
- Live stream capture with start/stop controls
- Download model recordings (VODs) from video pages
- Converts LL-HLS streams to standard MP4 files in your browser
- VR stream support with proper camera metadata
- Quality selection from all available HLS variants
- In-page download button right on the video player
- Real-time capture progress with segment counter and elapsed timer
- Right-click context menu for quick captures
- Dark-themed UI with coral pink accents
- 3 free downloads to try before you buy

Getting started:
1. Install the extension
2. Go to DreamCam and open a model page
3. Click the capture button on the player or the extension icon
4. For live: click Start to record, Stop to finish. For VODs: select quality and download.

Sign in with your email to unlock 3 free trial downloads. Upgrade to a license for unlimited captures and downloads.

Supports Chrome, Edge, Brave, Opera, Firefox, and more.

faq.question: How do I record a live stream?
faq.answer: Go to any live model page on DreamCam. Click the extension icon or the download button on the player. Click "Start" to begin recording. Click "Stop" when you want to finish — the recording saves as MP4.

faq.question: Can I download recorded videos (VODs)?
faq.answer: Yes. Navigate to a model's video page (e.g., /username/videos/123). The extension detects it as a recording and offers quality options for direct download.

faq.question: What quality options are available?
faq.answer: The extension parses all available HLS variants from the master manifest — typically multiple resolutions. Formats are sorted by quality (highest first).

faq.question: What format are downloaded videos?
faq.answer: All videos are saved as standard MP4 files that play on any device or media player.

faq.question: Where are my downloads saved?
faq.answer: Videos automatically save to a DREAMCAM subfolder inside your browser's default Downloads directory.

faq.question: How many free downloads do I get?
faq.answer: 3 free trial downloads after signing in with your email. Purchase a license for unlimited captures and downloads.

faq.question: Does this support VR streams?
faq.answer: Yes. The extension detects VR camera settings (stereo packing, frame format, horizontal angle) and includes VR metadata in the filename for proper playback in VR players.

faq.question: Does this work on Firefox?
faq.answer: Yes — supports Chrome, Edge, Brave, Opera, Whale, Yandex, and Firefox.

faq.question: Why isn't the extension finding the stream?
faq.answer: Make sure the model is currently live and streaming. If they're offline or in a private show, the extension will show a status message. Refresh the page and try again.

faq.question: Is my data safe?
faq.answer: Yes. All stream processing happens entirely in your browser. Authentication uses secure OTP — no passwords stored.
